page.overview:
What is Vivaldi Bank?

The Vivaldi Bank was founded by the Vivaldi family. Through their hard work, it became one of the Continent's most powerful banks.

The Vivaldi bank was already operating well before the human kingdoms had their first kings. Through the Vivaldi family's hard work, their bank became one of the two most powerful banks on the entire Continent. The bank's headquarters were located at their branch in Novigrad, but they established many other branches. They set up branches in all the larger cities in the North, and to oversee this vast network, they had key branches that oversaw specific regions. The Pont Vanis branch oversaw Kovir, Poviss, Caingorn, and Creyden. The Tretogor branch oversaw Redania and Kaedwen. The Vengerberg branch oversaw Aedirn, Lyria, and Sodden, and the Vizima branch oversaw Temeria and neighboring countries. Vimme Vivaldi carried the torch for his generation, making the Novigrad branch of the bank the largest bank in the city.

In early , the Vivaldi bank informed Molnar Giancardi that several attempts had been made to track the correspondence of the sorceress Yennefer of Vengerberg. The branch in Vengerberg also discovered an attempt by a disloyal clerk to track all transactions of her private accounts. Vivaldi either didn't or couldn't investigate the case, and the disloyal clerk ended up drowned in a ditch. They also informed Molnar of this.

The branch in Vizima encountered some financial difficulties, which led to a hostile takeover of the branch by humans, leaving the bank director Golan Vivaldi poor and bitter. The bank was used to pay the bail money for the criminal known as the Professor. The bank would eventually return to the family's control when the Scoia'tael under the command of Yaevinn stole documents that allowed Golan to regain control. After regaining control, Golan sent someone to check on the profitability of a mine in Vergen.
